name: Infiltration
shortDesc: NETWORM configuration and NetWatch Σ MK.1 inventory access

uploadSeconds.label: Upload HUD duration (s)
uploadSeconds.description: Duration of NETWORM's native upload progress bar; separate from infection timing.

scanRadius.label: Network pre-scan radius (m)
scanRadius.description: Range for scanning loaded eligible NPCs before propagation.

hopRadius.label: Relay hop radius (m)
hopRadius.description: Maximum distance to select another eligible infected host.

spreadInterval.label: Infection interval (s)
spreadInterval.description: Delay between NETWORM propagation steps; smaller values increase load.

maxJumps.label: Maximum infection steps
maxJumps.description: Upper bound on propagation ticks during a single NETWORM upload.

maxTargets.label: Maximum affected targets
maxTargets.description: Upper bound on the number of entities affected per upload.

fanout.label: Maximum fanout per host
fanout.description: Upper bound on how many relay connections one host may create.

give_deck.label: Get NetWatch Σ MK.1
give_deck.description: Grants one Items.NESTCyberdeck each click. For use when a ripperdoc does not stock it. Make sure a save is loaded.
